title: Turtle Cat Hybrid
description: A green and gold sea turtle with a detailed shell is positioned above a stylized red-orange cat with large heterochromatic eyes, one red and one green. The cat features intricate orange tribal patterns on its body and sits calmly while the turtle appears to float or merge above it, all set against a dark, swirling purple and grey smoky background with floating glass shards.
prompt: A mystical hybrid creature featuring a large green and gold sea turtle shell floating above a stylized red-orange tribal cat with one red eye and one green eye. The cat has intricate orange spiral patterns on its body and sits calmly. Dark swirling purple and grey smoke surrounds them with floating transparent glass shards. Dramatic fantasy lighting, highly detailed digital painting with glowing accents.
